Cowfusion#000.src: Yeah, yeah, I know. But what's it gonna matter if my back's worse than my grandpa's at the end of this?
Cowfusion#000.dst: Sí, sí, ya lo sé. Pero ¿de qué va a servir si al final acabo con la espalda peor que mi abuelo?

Cowfusion#002.src: A Human, eh? All the way out 'ere at the end of the canyon? Yer a tough one.
Cowfusion#002.dst: ¿Un humano, eh? ¿Tan lejos, aquí al final del cañón? Eres de los duros.
Cowfusion#002.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#003.src: Perhaps I can give yer some work, if yer are lookin' for it? Someone's been coming and nabbing my cows!
Cowfusion#003.dst: A lo mejor te doy trabajo, si es que lo buscas. ¡Alguien viene y me birla las vacas!
Cowfusion#003.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#004.src: 'an I know exactly who it is - that blasted cow scientist that lives in the lab just north of 'ere.
Cowfusion#004.dst: Y sé perfectamente quién es - ese maldito científico de vacas que vive en el laboratorio al norte de aquí.
Cowfusion#004.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#005.src: Anyway, yer up for the job? Can't let 'im just keep stealing them forever!
Cowfusion#005.dst: En fin, ¿te apuntas? ¡No puedo dejar que siga robándomelas para siempre!
Cowfusion#005.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#006.src: His cavern laboratory is just north from 'ere. Not too hard to find. Once yer there, get him to return my cows!
Cowfusion#006.dst: Su laboratorio en la cueva está justo al norte. No es difícil de hallar. ¡Cuando llegues, haz que me devuelva las vacas!
Cowfusion#006.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#007.src: There's one problem though. The door to the place is always shut, so you'll 'ave to find another way in.
Cowfusion#007.dst: Aunque hay un problema. La puerta siempre está cerrada, así que tendrás que buscar otra forma de entrar.
Cowfusion#007.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#009.src: Find a way into the Laboratory
Cowfusion#009.dst: Encuentra la forma de entrar en el laboratorio

Cowfusion#010.src: Search the Laboratory for the missing cows
Cowfusion#010.dst: Busca las vacas desaparecidas por el laboratorio

Cowfusion#011.src: Find a way to free the Cows.
Cowfusion#011.dst: Encuentra la forma de liberar a las vacas.

Cowfusion#015.dst: ¿Qué es esto de aquí? No me lo creo, ¿eres tú? ¡Mi niña, sabía que volverías conmigo!
Cowfusion#015.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#016.dst: ¡Y pensar que iba a contratar a un humano de ciudad para que te trajera! ¡Ja!
Cowfusion#016.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#017.dst: Muy bien, de vuelta al corral. ¡Hala!
Cowfusion#017.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#018.dst: Escapa de la granja de Ranol

Cowfusion#022.src: You're right, there is no password. Just seeing if you can understand me.
Cowfusion#022.dst: Tienes razón, no hay contraseña. Solo comprobaba si me entiendes.
Cowfusion#022.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#023.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#023.dst: ¿Eres de los nuestros, entonces, de los oprimidos? ¿Quieres librarte de estos granjeros? Pues estás de suerte.
Cowfusion#023.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#024.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#024.dst: Yo puedo ayudarte con eso. NOSOTROS podemos ayudarte con eso.
Cowfusion#024.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#025.src: Our people have a secret hideout not far from here. It's located right under that barn just behind me.
Cowfusion#025.dst: Los nuestros tienen un escondite secreto no muy lejos. Está justo debajo de ese granero que hay detrás de mí.
Cowfusion#025.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#026.src: It may seem close, but unless you've been practicing your atheletics, you won't be able to get over these fences.
Cowfusion#026.dst: Parece cerca, pero si no has entrenado atletismo, no vas a poder saltar estas vallas.
Cowfusion#026.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#027.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#027.dst: ¿Ves esa bala de paja en medio del corral? Seguro que puedes empujarla y tirar de ella hasta dejarla donde te permita saltar la valla con ese cuerpo de vaca.
Cowfusion#027.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#028.src: The second pen might have a similar problem, but I'm sure you can figure that out yourself.
Cowfusion#028.dst: El segundo corral quizá tenga un problema parecido, pero seguro que lo resuelves tú solo.
Cowfusion#028.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#032.src: What? What does that even mean? There isn't actually a password! Or did no one tell me that there was? Ah, nevermind, at least you can understand me.
Cowfusion#032.dst: ¿Qué? ¿Y eso qué significa? ¡No hay contraseña de verdad! ¿O es que nadie me dijo que sí la había? Ah, da igual, al menos me entiendes.
Cowfusion#032.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#033.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#033.dst: ¿Eres de los nuestros, entonces, de los oprimidos? ¿Quieres librarte de estos granjeros? Pues estás de suerte.
Cowfusion#033.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#034.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#034.dst: Yo puedo ayudarte con eso. NOSOTROS podemos ayudarte con eso.
Cowfusion#034.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#035.dst: Los nuestros tienen un escondite secreto no muy lejos. Está justo debajo de ese granero que hay detrás de mí.
Cowfusion#035.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#036.dst: Parece cerca, pero si no has entrenado atletismo, no vas a poder saltar estas vallas.
Cowfusion#036.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#037.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#037.dst: ¿Ves esa bala de paja en medio del corral? Seguro que puedes empujarla y tirar de ella hasta dejarla donde te permita saltar la valla con ese cuerpo de vaca.
Cowfusion#037.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#038.dst: El segundo corral quizá tenga un problema parecido, pero seguro que lo resuelves tú solo.
Cowfusion#038.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#040.src: Find and enter the Secret Cow Hideout
Cowfusion#040.dst: Encuentra y entra en el Escondite Secreto de las Vacas

Cowfusion#041.dst: Habla con quien está en recepción

Cowfusion#042.src: Oh, a new recruit? We weren't expecting anyone at this time. How'd you find your way in?
Cowfusion#042.dst: ¿Ah, un recluta nuevo? No esperábamos a nadie a estas horas. ¿Cómo has encontrado la entrada?
Cowfusion#042.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#043.src: Wait, you're different. Something's off about you. Like you've never been in a cow's body before.
Cowfusion#043.dst: Espera, tú eres distinto. Hay algo raro en ti. Como si nunca hubieras estado en un cuerpo de vaca.
Cowfusion#043.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#044.src: Oh. Oh, this is not good. Uhm, you should talk to the boss. He'll probably know what to do with you.
Cowfusion#044.dst: Ah. Ah, esto no es bueno. Eh, deberías hablar con el jefe. Él sabrá qué hacer contigo.
Cowfusion#044.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#045.src: You'll find him in the big office at the very end of this facility. Just stick to the path and don't be nosey, okay?
Cowfusion#045.dst: Lo encontrarás en el despacho grande al final de estas instalaciones. Sigue el camino y no fisgues, ¿vale?
Cowfusion#045.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#046.src: Find the one who's in charge of the hideout
Cowfusion#046.dst: Encuentra a quien manda en el escondite

Cowfusion#048.src: Whoop, alright! Don't want you going anywhere, buddy! Uh... What are you doing here, exactly...?
Cowfusion#048.dst: ¡Uy, muy bien! ¡No quiero que te vayas a ningún lado, amigo! Eh... ¿Qué haces aquí exactamente...?
Cowfusion#048.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#049.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#049.dst: ¿Tú- qué? Madre mía, ¿cómo es eso posible? No creo que tuviera nada capaz de...
Cowfusion#049.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#050.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?
Cowfusion#050.dst: ¡Ah! Habrás estado fisgando por mi laboratorio. Eso... vale, de eso hablamos luego. ¿Te metiste en mi máquina?
Cowfusion#050.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#051.src: It's not even meant to do that! Its purpose is to turn the exiles back into Wocs. So how does a Human become a cow...?
Cowfusion#051.dst: ¡Si ni siquiera sirve para eso! Su función es devolver a los exiliados a su forma de Woc. ¿Cómo se vuelve vaca un humano...?
Cowfusion#051.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#052.src: Right, right, sorry. Here, uh- I'll try and get this cage down. Darn controls... Why did I design these so poorly?
Cowfusion#052.dst: Sí, sí, perdona. Toma, eh- intentaré bajar esta jaula. Malditos controles... ¿Por qué los diseñé tan mal?
Cowfusion#052.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#053.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?
Cowfusion#053.dst: ...Mientras averiguo qué palanca hay que mover, ¡háblame de ti! ¿Algo interesante en tu vida?
Cowfusion#053.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#054.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#054.dst: ¿Tú... lo eres? ¡Lo eres! ¡Ah, vaya, qué bien verte otra vez! ¡Cuánto ha pasado desde nuestras andanzas en Wynn!
Cowfusion#054.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#055.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#055.dst: ¡Esto es genial, la verdad! ¡Pu- puedo enseñarte todo esto! ¡Presentarte a algunos de los que liberamos juntos! Ay, qué momento más oportuno.
Cowfusion#055.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#056.src: I just need to figure out which switch to pull... I think it's this one! Probably. I really need to label these things. Alright, here goes!
Cowfusion#056.dst: Solo tengo que dar con el interruptor... ¡Creo que es este! Probablemente. Debería etiquetar estas cosas. ¡Vale, allá va!
Cowfusion#056.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#058.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.
Cowfusion#058.dst: Yo, eh... Ja. Muy gracioso. Me dices que eres humano y luego finges ser una vaca.
Cowfusion#058.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#059.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#059.dst: Eso... está bien. Mira, ahora mismo tengo muchísimo estrés. Trabajando sin parar, día tras día. ¡No necesito esa actitud tuya ahora!
Cowfusion#059.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#060.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#060.dst: ¿Sabes qué? No necesito esta actitud. Voy- voy a mandarte al Pozo. Donde- donde yacen todos mis otros errores.
Cowfusion#060.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#061.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#061.dst: ...Tienes un arma. ¡Seguro que te las apañas! ¡No necesitas nada de mí! ¡Toma, a ver si te gusta ahí abajo!
Cowfusion#061.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#063.src: Okay. So you are just a regular cow. Not a Woc. Uh... Who let you in, little pal? I'm going to need to have to have a word about closing the doors...
Cowfusion#063.dst: Vale. Así que solo eres una vaca normal. No una Woc. Eh... ¿Quién te dejó entrar, amiguito? Voy a tener que hablar con alguien sobre cerrar las puertas...
Cowfusion#063.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#064.src: Well, this is... awkward. So, then... cow. What's it like being... a cow?
Cowfusion#064.dst: Bueno, esto es... incómodo. Pues... vaca. ¿Qué tal es ser... una vaca?
Cowfusion#064.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#065.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#065.dst: ¿Tú- qué? Madre mía, ¿cómo es eso posible? No creo que tuviera nada capaz de...
Cowfusion#065.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#075.dst: Eso... está bien. Mira, ahora mismo tengo muchísimo estrés. Trabajando sin parar, día tras día. ¡No necesito esa actitud tuya ahora!
Cowfusion#075.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#076.dst: ¿Sabes qué? No necesito esta actitud. Voy- voy a mandarte al Pozo. Donde- donde yacen todos mis otros errores.
Cowfusion#076.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#077.dst: ...Tienes un arma. ¡Seguro que te las apañas! ¡No necesitas nada de mí! ¡Toma, a ver si te gusta ahí abajo!
Cowfusion#077.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#079.src: Right. Okay. Figure I'd best let you go free.
Cowfusion#079.dst: Ya. Vale. Creo que lo mejor es dejarte libre.
Cowfusion#079.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#080.src: ...Unless. Unless. Nobody's... nobody's looking. I could just send you to The Pit... Nobody would know.
Cowfusion#080.dst: ...A no ser. A no ser. Que nadie... que nadie mire. Podría mandarte al Pozo... Nadie lo sabría.
Cowfusion#080.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#081.src: It's... easier this way. It's fine. Maybe you'll even- maybe you'll even make your way out. Good luck, little buddy.
Cowfusion#081.dst: Es... más fácil así. No pasa nada. Quizá incluso- quizá incluso consigas salir. Suerte, amiguito.
Cowfusion#081.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#084.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#084.dst: ¿Que caíste en la incineradora? ¿Y venciste a una vaca mutante monstruosa?
Cowfusion#084.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#085.src: ...Oh! You're the one Drale told us to look out for. Accidentally dropped into the Pit, huh?
Cowfusion#085.dst: ...¡Ah! Eres a quien Drale nos dijo que vigiláramos. Caíste al Pozo sin querer, ¿eh?
Cowfusion#085.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#086.src: The boss said to apologize to ya for the inconvenience. We've all been workin' late hours recently... Some of us more than others.
Cowfusion#086.dst: El jefe dijo que te pidiéramos perdón por las molestias. Últimamente todos hacemos horas hasta tarde... Unos más que otros.
Cowfusion#086.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#087.src: Anyhow, follow me. I'll take you back to him, and you can talk this out! You'll be back as a human in no time.
Cowfusion#087.dst: En fin, sígueme. Te llevo de vuelta con él y lo habláis. ¡Volverás a ser humano enseguida!
Cowfusion#087.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#088.src: So... yeah. That's Drale for you. Absentminded as ever. He said something about labeling his levers from now on, so I reckon that's a positive.
Cowfusion#088.dst: Así que... eso. Ese es Drale. Despistado como siempre. Dijo algo de etiquetar las palancas a partir de ahora, o sea que algo bueno hay.
Cowfusion#088.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#089.src: ...You're a good friend of the boss, right? Would you be able to put in a good word for us? Gerald and I have been down here for a while, and we'd like to get back to our normal positions.
Cowfusion#089.dst: ...Eres buen amigo del jefe, ¿no? ¿Podrías poner una palabra por nosotros? Gerald y yo llevamos aquí abajo un buen rato, y nos gustaría volver a nuestros puestos normales.
Cowfusion#089.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#090.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#090.dst: Drale no está mal en un buen día, ¡pero últimamente se nos acaban los buenos días! ¡No para de trasnochar con ese proyecto... totalmente innecesario!
Cowfusion#090.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#091.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#091.dst: ¡Insiste en seguir buscando nuestra nave original en vez de construir una nueva con todo el material que tenemos! ¡Es ridículo!
Cowfusion#091.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#092.src: Maybe you'll be able to get through to him, being his friend and all. We've all been stressed, and it's really just...
Cowfusion#092.dst: A lo mejor tú puedes hacerle entrar en razón, siendo su amigo y tal. Todos estamos estresados, y de verdad que...
Cowfusion#092.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#093.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#093.dst: ¿Qué nave? Ah, claro, tú no eres un Woc. Verás, nuestra raza no es de- oye, mejor dejamos esa historia para otro día.
Cowfusion#093.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#094.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab. Drale will be glad to see you in one piece! He sounded worried for your safety.
Cowfusion#094.dst: Por ahora subamos al laboratorio principal. ¡A Drale le alegrará verte de una pieza! Parecía preocupado por ti.
Cowfusion#094.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#096.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#096.dst: Sube por esa tubería y, con un poco de suerte, te escupirá justo delante de Drale.
Cowfusion#096.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#097.src: Remember what I told you! Try to put in a good word for us, yeah?
Cowfusion#097.dst: ¡Recuerda lo que te dije! Intenta hablar bien de nosotros, ¿vale?
Cowfusion#097.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#098.src: If not, well... At least I tried. Let the record show I tried.
Cowfusion#098.dst: Y si no, bueno... Al menos lo intenté. Que conste que lo intenté.
Cowfusion#098.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#099.src: ...Alright! Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#099.dst: ...¡Venga! ¡Anda, largo! Ha sido un placer conocerte.
Cowfusion#099.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#101.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#101.dst: ¿Que caíste en la incineradora? ¿Y venciste a una vaca mutante monstruosa?
Cowfusion#101.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#102.src: Yeah that checks out. So what happened to get you thrown down here?
Cowfusion#102.dst: Sí, eso cuadra. ¿Y qué pasó para que te tiraran aquí abajo?
Cowfusion#102.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#103.src: Oh, angered him by pretending to be a cow after already speaking? Yeah, I feel ya. When the boss is in a mood, anything you say could get you thrown down here.
Cowfusion#103.dst: Ah, ¿lo enfadaste fingiendo ser vaca tras haber hablado? Ya, te entiendo. Cuando el jefe está de humor, cualquier cosa que digas te manda aquí abajo.
Cowfusion#103.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#104.src: Here, why don't you follow me? I'll take you back to him, you can straighten things out, and I'm sure you'll be back as a human in no time!
Cowfusion#104.dst: Mira, ¿por qué no me sigues? Te llevo con él, lo aclaráis, ¡y seguro que vuelves a ser humano enseguida!
Cowfusion#104.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#105.src: So... yeah. Drale isn't the best at... conflict resolution. Catch him on a bad day, and he might just throw you in the Pit.
Cowfusion#105.dst: Así que... eso. Drale no es el mejor en... resolver conflictos. Píllalo en un mal día y te tira al Pozo sin más.
Cowfusion#105.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#106.src: I got stationed down here for a week because I interrupted him during his daily yoga session.
Cowfusion#106.dst: A mí me destinaron aquí abajo una semana por interrumpirle su sesión diaria de yoga.
Cowfusion#106.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#107.src: Gerald, over there? He used to be in accounting. Until he forgot to carry the two one day, and... Well, here he is now.
Cowfusion#107.dst: ¿Gerald, el de allí? Antes era contable. Hasta que un día olvidó llevarse dos, y... Bueno, ahí lo tienes.
Cowfusion#107.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#108.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#108.dst: Drale no está mal en un buen día, ¡pero últimamente se nos acaban los buenos días! ¡No para de trasnochar con ese proyecto... totalmente innecesario!
Cowfusion#108.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#109.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#109.dst: ¡Insiste en seguir buscando nuestra nave original en vez de construir una nueva con todo el material que tenemos! ¡Es ridículo!
Cowfusion#109.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#110.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#110.dst: ¿Qué nave? Ah, claro, tú no eres un Woc. Verás, nuestra raza no es de- oye, mejor dejamos esa historia para otro día.
Cowfusion#110.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#111.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab and hopefully Drale will be in a bit of a better mood!
Cowfusion#111.dst: Por ahora subamos al laboratorio principal, ¡y ojalá Drale esté de mejor humor!
Cowfusion#111.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#113.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#113.dst: Sube por esa tubería y, con un poco de suerte, te escupirá justo delante de Drale.
Cowfusion#113.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#114.src: If you try explaining the situation again I'm sure he'll be understanding.
Cowfusion#114.dst: Si le explicas la situación otra vez, seguro que lo entiende.
Cowfusion#114.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#115.src: He usually is after he's had some time to cool off.
Cowfusion#115.dst: Suele entenderlo cuando se le pasa el enfado.
Cowfusion#115.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#116.src: Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#116.dst: ¡Anda, largo! Ha sido un placer conocerte.
Cowfusion#116.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#118.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#118.dst: ¿Que caíste en la incineradora? ¿Y venciste a una vaca mutante monstruosa?
Cowfusion#118.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#119.src: Yeah that checks out. So what happened to get you thrown down here?
Cowfusion#119.dst: Sí, eso cuadra. ¿Y qué pasó para que te tiraran aquí abajo?
Cowfusion#119.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#120.src: Pretended to be a cow when you're actually a human? Must have caught him on a rough day to get thrown down for that. Usually he'd just let a cow go.
Cowfusion#120.dst: ¿Fingiste ser una vaca siendo humano? Lo habrás pillado en un mal día para que te tirara por eso. Normalmente dejaría ir a una vaca sin más.
Cowfusion#120.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#121.src: Well here, why don't you follow me? I'll take you back to him, you can straighten things out, and I'm sure you'll be back as a human in no time!
Cowfusion#121.dst: Bueno, mira, ¿por qué no me sigues? Te llevo con él, lo aclaráis, ¡y seguro que vuelves a ser humano enseguida!
Cowfusion#121.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#122.src: So... yeah. That's Drale. Catch him on a bad day, and he might just throw you into the Pit.
Cowfusion#122.dst: Así que... eso. Ese es Drale. Píllalo en un mal día y te tira al Pozo sin más.
Cowfusion#122.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#123.src: I got stationed down here for a week because I interrupted him during his daily yoga session.
Cowfusion#123.dst: A mí me destinaron aquí abajo una semana por interrumpirle su sesión diaria de yoga.
Cowfusion#123.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#124.src: Gerald, over there? He used to be in accounting. Until he forgot to carry the two one day, and... Well, here he is now.
Cowfusion#124.dst: ¿Gerald, el de allí? Antes era contable. Hasta que un día olvidó llevarse dos, y... Bueno, ahí lo tienes.
Cowfusion#124.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#125.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#125.dst: Drale no está mal en un buen día, ¡pero últimamente se nos acaban los buenos días! ¡No para de trasnochar con ese proyecto... totalmente innecesario!
Cowfusion#125.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#126.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#126.dst: ¡Insiste en seguir buscando nuestra nave original en vez de construir una nueva con todo el material que tenemos! ¡Es ridículo!
Cowfusion#126.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#127.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#127.dst: ¿Qué nave? Ah, claro, tú no eres un Woc. Verás, nuestra raza no es de- oye, mejor dejamos esa historia para otro día.
Cowfusion#127.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#128.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab and hopefully Drale will be in a bit of a better mood! Maybe mention the human thing this time, alright?
Cowfusion#128.dst: Por ahora subamos al laboratorio principal, ¡y ojalá Drale esté de mejor humor! Esta vez menciona lo de ser humano, ¿vale?
Cowfusion#128.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#130.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#130.dst: Sube por esa tubería y, con un poco de suerte, te escupirá justo delante de Drale.
Cowfusion#130.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#131.src: If you try explaining the situation again I'm sure he'll be understanding.
Cowfusion#131.dst: Si le explicas la situación otra vez, seguro que lo entiende.
Cowfusion#131.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#132.src: He usually is after he's had some time to cool off.
Cowfusion#132.dst: Suele entenderlo cuando se le pasa el enfado.
Cowfusion#132.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#133.src: Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#133.dst: ¡Anda, largo! Ha sido un placer conocerte.
Cowfusion#133.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#135.src: Oh, this is- Oh! You're alive! I, ah- heh. Sorry about... all that. I really, really need to label these levers properly...
Cowfusion#135.dst: Ah, esto es- ¡Ah! ¡Estás vivo! Yo, ah- je. Perdona por... todo eso. Tengo que etiquetar bien estas palancas, de verdad...
Cowfusion#135.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#136.src: Right! Right. You'se seen... all that down there, then. I just hope you won't think less of me for it.
Cowfusion#136.dst: ¡Ya! Ya. Así que has visto... todo aquello de ahí abajo. Solo espero que no me tengas en menos por ello.
Cowfusion#136.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#137.src: I can... I can tell you more about it later. I hope it wasn't too bad? Down there? You seen to have gotten out in one piece, so...
Cowfusion#137.dst: Puedo... puedo contarte más luego. ¿Espero que no fuera muy malo? ¿Ahí abajo? Parece que saliste de una pieza, así que...
Cowfusion#137.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#138.src: ...Oh. Right. Gosh, how long has it been since I-...
Cowfusion#138.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#139.src: Okay. Alright, yes, I'll give them better positions. And I'll- I don't know. Apologize. Give them a bonus.
Cowfusion#139.dst: Vale. Está bien, sí, les daré mejores puestos. Y voy a- no sé. Pedir perdón. Darles una paga extra.
Cowfusion#139.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#140.src: It's been... hard, recently. We've been working to get back home, and I guess I just... Put too much of myself into that. It's fine! Don't- Don't worry about me.
Cowfusion#140.dst: Ha sido... duro, últimamente. Trabajamos para volver a casa, y supongo que me he... volcado demasiado en eso. ¡No pasa nada! No- No te preocupes por mí.
Cowfusion#140.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#141.src: Oh. Right, your body! I can fix that! We just need to get back to the machine, and... Poof. You'll be back to normal!
Cowfusion#141.dst: Ah. ¡Cierto, tu cuerpo! ¡Eso lo arreglo! Solo hay que volver a la máquina y... Pum. ¡Estarás como siempre!
Cowfusion#141.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#142.src: ...I hope. Hey, being a cow isn't so bad! If- If it doesn't work, we can make you a home here...?
Cowfusion#142.dst: ...Eso espero. ¡Oye, ser vaca no está tan mal! Si- Si no funciona, ¿te hacemos un hogar aquí...?
Cowfusion#142.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#143.src: Uh... It'll work. It's always- always worked in the past! Heh...
Cowfusion#143.dst: Eh... Funcionará. ¡Siempre- siempre ha funcionado antes! Je...
Cowfusion#143.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#145.src: Uh... Hm. Maybe- Maybe being a cow is affecting your brain somehow... That can't be good.
Cowfusion#145.dst: Eh... Mm. Quizá- Quizá ser vaca te esté afectando al cerebro... Eso no puede ser bueno.
Cowfusion#145.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#146.src: We should get you back to human as quickly as possible. Come on, follow me.
Cowfusion#146.dst: Deberíamos devolverte a humano cuanto antes. Venga, sígueme.
Cowfusion#146.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#147.src: ...This doesn't even mean anything! What am I supposed to do with-
Cowfusion#147.dst: ...¡Esto no significa nada! ¿Qué se supone que hago con-
Cowfusion#147.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#148.src: Oh! It's- It's you! Didn't I just...
Cowfusion#148.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#149.src: ...Um. This is... really awkward, haha. I'm... sorry?
Cowfusion#149.dst: ...Eh. Esto es... muy incómodo, jaja. ¿Lo... siento?
Cowfusion#149.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#150.src: You're... the one who pretended to be a cow, right? I, uh... in my defense, I was very stressed. So I dropped you into the Pit.
Cowfusion#150.dst: Tú eres... el que fingió ser una vaca, ¿verdad? Yo, eh... en mi defensa, estaba muy estresado. Así que te tiré al Pozo.
Cowfusion#150.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#151.src: ...Anyway! What's- What's going on with your life? Anything interesting?
Cowfusion#151.dst: ...¡En fin! ¿Qué- qué tal tu vida? ¿Algo interesante?
Cowfusion#151.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#152.src: Oh! Right. Getting back to normal.
Cowfusion#152.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#153.src: You said you stepped into my machine, right? We could try putting you in there a second time. What's the worst that could happen?
Cowfusion#153.dst: Dijiste que te metiste en mi máquina, ¿no? Podríamos probar a meterte una segunda vez. ¿Qué es lo peor que puede pasar?
Cowfusion#153.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#154.src: ...Uh. You stay as a cow. That's what. That's... fine. Let's just go and try it out.
Cowfusion#154.dst: ...Eh. Que te quedes de vaca. Eso. Eso... está bien. Venga, vamos a probarlo.
Cowfusion#154.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#155.src: ...This doesn't even mean anything! What am I supposed to do with-
Cowfusion#155.dst: ...¡Esto no significa nada! ¿Qué se supone que hago con-
Cowfusion#155.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#156.src: Oh! It's- It's you! Didn't I just...
Cowfusion#156.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#157.src: ...Um. This is... really awkward, haha. I'm... sorry?
Cowfusion#157.dst: ...Eh. Esto es... muy incómodo, jaja. ¿Lo... siento?
Cowfusion#157.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#158.src: I am talking to a cow. Again. Why is this where my life has taken me.
Cowfusion#158.dst: Estoy hablando con una vaca. Otra vez. Por qué habrá acabado así mi vida.
Cowfusion#158.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#159.src: So! What's... going on, little buddy? Any- any souvenirs? From the Pit...?
Cowfusion#159.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#160.src: Oh, you- Oh. Right! Okay. I don't- I don't quite understand why you would pretend to be a cow. But alright!
Cowfusion#160.dst: Ah, tú- Ah. ¡Ya! Vale. No- No acabo de entender por qué fingirías ser una vaca. ¡Pero bueno!
Cowfusion#160.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#161.src: So, uh... Human turned into a cow. Okay. How did you manage to get yourself stuck as a cow, anyway? I didn't think we had anything that could do that...
Cowfusion#161.dst: Así que, eh... Un humano convertido en vaca. Vale. ¿Y cómo te las apañaste para quedarte atrapado como vaca? No creía que tuviéramos nada capaz de eso...
Cowfusion#161.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#162.src: My machine. It's- It's not even supposed to do that! I designed it to turn exiles back into Wocs, how would it have...
Cowfusion#162.dst: Mi máquina. ¡Si- si ni siquiera sirve para eso! La diseñé para devolver a los exiliados a Woc, ¿cómo iba a...
Cowfusion#162.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#163.src: Great. Of course it'd have that issue, and just when I thought I...
Cowfusion#163.dst: Genial. Cómo no iba a tener ese fallo, y justo cuando creía que...
Cowfusion#163.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#164.src: Right. Right. Alright. We can work with this! Let's just take you back to that machine, put you in it, and see if it turns you back to normal!
Cowfusion#164.dst: Ya. Ya. Bien. ¡Con esto podemos trabajar! Te llevamos de vuelta a la máquina, te metemos dentro, ¡y a ver si te devuelve a la normalidad!
Cowfusion#164.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#165.src: It'll work. Probably. I mean, I haven't ever tried it, so I can't really say for sure... Oh, yep, you're still here. Let's get moving.
Cowfusion#165.dst: Funcionará. Probablemente. O sea, nunca lo he probado, así que no puedo asegurarlo... Ah, sí, sigues aquí. En marcha.
Cowfusion#165.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#166.src: Uh... Hm. Maybe- Maybe being a cow is affecting your brain somehow... That can't be good.
Cowfusion#166.dst: Eh... Mm. Quizá- Quizá ser vaca te esté afectando al cerebro... Eso no puede ser bueno.
Cowfusion#166.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#167.src: We should get you back to human as quickly as possible. Come on, follow me.
Cowfusion#167.dst: Deberíamos devolverte a humano cuanto antes. Venga, sígueme.
Cowfusion#167.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#169.src: Well, alright. Let's just- get you in my machine, I guess. It worked for the exiles, so maybe it will work for you...?
Cowfusion#169.dst: Bueno, vale. Pues- te meto en mi máquina, supongo. Con los exiliados funcionó, ¿quizá contigo también...?
Cowfusion#169.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#170.src: ...Don't look at me like that. Come on, let's get going.
Cowfusion#170.dst: ...No me mires así. Venga, en marcha.
Cowfusion#170.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#171.src: So... How have you been? It's been a while since our adventure at {p}, hasn't it?
Cowfusion#171.dst: Bueno... ¿Cómo te ha ido? Ha pasado tiempo desde nuestra aventura en {p}, ¿verdad?
Cowfusion#171.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#172.src: Well, you've been turned into a cow... Obviously... But besides that!
Cowfusion#172.dst: Bueno, te han convertido en vaca... Obviamente... ¡Pero aparte de eso!
Cowfusion#172.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#173.src: Me? Well... heh. I've been doing pretty well, all thing considered. We've been gathering exiles from all over the province! Set up a city for us all while we work towards...
Cowfusion#173.dst: ¿Yo? Bueno... je. Me ha ido bastante bien, pensándolo todo. ¡Hemos ido reuniendo exiliados de toda la provincia! Montamos una ciudad para todos mientras trabajamos por...
Cowfusion#173.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#174.src: It's a long story. I can't tell you everything- not yet. But... All of us here, we don't belong here. We just want to go home.
Cowfusion#174.dst: Es una historia larga. No puedo contártelo todo- aún no. Pero... Todos los que estamos aquí no pertenecemos a este sitio. Solo queremos volver a casa.
Cowfusion#174.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#175.src: And- and maybe if we can find our ship again, we'll be able to prove that we're not irredeemable. That whatever we went through- that it won't define us.
Cowfusion#175.dst: Y- y quizá, si encontramos nuestra nave, podamos demostrar que no somos irrecuperables. Que lo que pasamos- que eso no nos define.
Cowfusion#175.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#176.src: ...Heh. Don't- don't worry about it too much. For now, this place is enough of a safe haven for us. It'll have to be enough until we succeed.
Cowfusion#176.dst: ...Je. No- no le des muchas vueltas. Por ahora, este sitio nos basta como refugio. Tendrá que bastar hasta que lo logremos.
Cowfusion#176.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#177.src: We're so close. I can feel it. Just... Just a little while left to go.
Cowfusion#177.dst: Estamos muy cerca. Lo noto. Solo... Solo queda un poco.
Cowfusion#177.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#178.src: Anyway, uh... Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#178.dst: En fin, eh... ¡Aquí está el ascensor! Entra y subimos al laboratorio.
Cowfusion#178.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#179.src: The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
Cowfusion#179.dst: La- ah. Eh... No es nada. Nada de qué preocuparse.
Cowfusion#179.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#180.src: It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
Cowfusion#180.dst: Solo lleva a... mantenimiento. ¡Sí! Solo- solo mantenimiento. Nada más.
Cowfusion#180.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#181.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#181.dst: ¡Al ascensor ya, venga! Igualmente hace falta una llave para entrar, ¡y desde luego yo no tengo ninguna por ahí!
Cowfusion#181.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#182.src: ...You're worrying me, friend. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#182.dst: ...Me estás preocupando, amigo. Venga, en marcha. Al ascensor, vamos a devolverte a la normalidad.
Cowfusion#182.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#183.src: So... Have you done anything interesting recently? Besides- getting turned into a cow. Obviously.
Cowfusion#183.dst: Bueno... ¿Has hecho algo interesante últimamente? Aparte de- convertirte en vaca. Obviamente.
Cowfusion#183.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#184.src: You're, uh... Probably wondering what this place is. Just a big city under some random guy's farm, right?
Cowfusion#184.dst: Estarás, eh... preguntándote qué es este sitio. Una gran ciudad bajo la granja de un tipo cualquiera, ¿no?
Cowfusion#184.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#185.src: It's... heh. We've been trying to gather as many of our people as we can. We exiles have to stick together, after all.
Cowfusion#185.dst: Es... je. Intentamos reunir a todos los nuestros que podamos. Los exiliados tenemos que apoyarnos, al fin y al cabo.
Cowfusion#185.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#186.src: It's a long story. I'm not sure how much of it I really want to tell you, heh. Especially considering... Yeah.
Cowfusion#186.dst: Es una historia larga. No sé cuánto quiero contarte de ella, je. Sobre todo teniendo en cuenta... Ya.
Cowfusion#186.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#187.src: But. This place is a safe haven for us exiles. A place for us all to live until we achieve our goals.
Cowfusion#187.dst: Pero. Este sitio es un refugio para los exiliados. Un lugar donde vivir hasta lograr nuestros objetivos.
Cowfusion#187.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#188.src: And- hey! You've seen our secrets now! May as well let it be a safe haven for you as well, right? Heh.
Cowfusion#188.dst: Y- ¡oye! ¡Ya has visto nuestros secretos! Pues que sea un refugio para ti también, ¿no? Je.
Cowfusion#188.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#189.src: Oh- the elevator. Here we are. Uh... Just head on in, little buddy? It'll take us up.
Cowfusion#189.dst: Ah- el ascensor. Ya estamos. Eh... Entra, ¿vale, amiguito? Nos subirá.
Cowfusion#189.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#190.src: The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
Cowfusion#190.dst: La- ah. Eh... No es nada. Nada de qué preocuparse.
Cowfusion#190.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#191.src: It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
Cowfusion#191.dst: Solo lleva a... mantenimiento. ¡Sí! Solo- solo mantenimiento. Nada más.
Cowfusion#191.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#192.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#192.dst: ¡Al ascensor ya, venga! Igualmente hace falta una llave para entrar, ¡y desde luego yo no tengo ninguna por ahí!
Cowfusion#192.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#193.src: ...You're worrying me. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#193.dst: ...Me estás preocupando. Venga, en marcha. Al ascensor, vamos a devolverte a la normalidad.
Cowfusion#193.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#195.src: Uh. Do you- do you understand what I'm saying?
Cowfusion#195.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#196.src: ...This is stupid. I'm talking to a cow. Of course you can't...
Cowfusion#196.dst: ...Esto es absurdo. Hablo con una vaca. Claro que no puedes...
Cowfusion#196.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#198.src: Well I guess I could- talk at you. For a bit. If that's, heh, fine with you!
Cowfusion#198.dst: Bueno, supongo que podría- hablarte. Un rato. ¡Si a ti, je, te parece bien!
Cowfusion#198.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#199.src: It's been tough, recently. Working towards a goal I know is important, but still feels... out of reach.
Cowfusion#199.dst: Ha sido duro, últimamente. Trabajar por una meta que sé que importa, pero que sigue pareciendo... inalcanzable.
Cowfusion#199.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#200.src: And it doesn't seem like anybody else can see that! That this is important! They look at me like I'm going crazy, and-
Cowfusion#200.dst: ¡Y parece que nadie más lo ve! ¡Que esto importa! Me miran como si me estuviera volviendo loco, y-
Cowfusion#200.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#201.src: I'm not. I know I'm not. We need to find the ship. If we don't, who knows what...
Cowfusion#201.dst: No lo estoy. Sé que no. Hay que hallar la nave. Si no, quién sabe qué...
Cowfusion#201.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#202.src: Anyway! Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#202.dst: ¡En fin! ¡Aquí está el ascensor! Entra y subimos al laboratorio.
Cowfusion#202.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#203.src: Hrrgh- You're- you're not a cow?! Why would you... I just said all that, and you could...
Cowfusion#203.dst: Grrj- ¿Tú- tú no eres una vaca? ¿Por qué ibas a... Acabo de decir todo eso, y tú podías...
Cowfusion#203.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#204.src: D-Don't worry about the door. It's... It's nothing. Maintenance. That- that's what it is.
Cowfusion#204.dst: N-No te preocupes por la puerta. Es... No es nada. Mantenimiento. Eso- eso es lo que es.
Cowfusion#204.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#205.src: Er... come on, into the elevator! You want to get back to normal, right? Besides, you'd need a key to get in there, and I don't know where you'd find one of those, haha!
Cowfusion#205.dst: Eh... ¡venga, al ascensor! Quieres volver a la normalidad, ¿no? Además, necesitarías una llave para entrar ahí, y no sé dónde encontrarías una, ¡jaja!
Cowfusion#205.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#206.src: ...Moo. Yep. I agree. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator.
Cowfusion#206.dst: ...Muu. Sí. Estoy de acuerdo. Venga, en marcha. Al ascensor.
Cowfusion#206.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#207.src: So... here we are. The lab!
Cowfusion#207.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#208.src: Just... follow me, for now. The machine is this way.
Cowfusion#208.dst: Solo... sígueme, de momento. La máquina está por aquí.
Cowfusion#208.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#209.src: There it is! If you step into the machine, real quick, it should... it should work!
Cowfusion#209.dst: ¡Ahí está! Si te metes en la máquina, rapidito, debería... ¡debería funcionar!
Cowfusion#209.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#210.dst: Entra en la Máquina de Transmutación

Cowfusion#211.src: Look at you! As good as new!
Cowfusion#211.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#213.src: Heh... Well, there you are! Good as new! I hope...
Cowfusion#213.dst: Je... ¡Bueno, ahí estás! ¡Como nuevo! Eso espero...
Cowfusion#213.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#214.src: And- to, uh, compensate you for... you know... Here! One liquid emerald. I feel terrible for how our reunion ended up going... I hope you won't hold it against me?
Cowfusion#214.dst: Y- para, eh, compensarte por... ya sabes... ¡Toma! Una esmeralda líquida. Me siento fatal por cómo salió nuestro reencuentro... ¿Espero que no me lo tengas en cuenta?
Cowfusion#214.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#217.src: There you are! Back to norm...-

Cowfusion#218.src: {u}?! What are you- that was you the whole time?! Why didn't you tell me!

Cowfusion#218.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#219.src: Oh gosh, this has been... An awful reunion. I can't believe I dropped you into the Pit...

Cowfusion#219.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#220.src: I'm so sorry for- for all of that. You should have told me! Oh...

Cowfusion#221.src: Okay, uh... Here, take this. As- as compensation for- for all of that.
